structure.unit: State Authorities, Boards, Commissions, Councils, Foundations and Other Collegial Bodies
Joint Leadership Council of Veterans Service Organizations

text.section: The chairman shall report to the Commissioner and the Board of Veterans Services the results of its meetings and submit an annual report on or before November 30 of each year.

The Council may apply for funds from the Veterans Services Foundation to enable it to better carry out its objectives. The Council shall not impose unreasonable burdens or costs in connection with requests of agencies.
